summary: Comprehensive first-pass test of Souq Market (Arabic RTL supermarket app). Backend: 26/26 pytest tests pass covering auth (register/login/me for all 3 seeded roles), RBAC (customer→admin=403, delivery→product-create=403, customer→catalog=403), catalog lookup for barcode 8699449876882 (returns 'بهار مرسين'), products list/filter(offers)/search/categories, manager product CRUD with GET-verified persistence, cart add/update/remove, favorites toggle, order creation storing {lat,lng}, full order lifecycle (manager confirm→preparing→assign→delivery-marks-delivered) where the delivery agent's /delivery/orders response includes the customer location, admin stats/orders-filter/agents/set-role. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): login screen renders in RTL Arabic, customer login lands on home tab with hero banner, categories chips, and product grid with discount badges; add-to-cart→cart tab→checkout screen (name/phone/address/notes inputs + GPS button + Yandex map card + COD info)→order placed→navigated to /order/[id]?new=1 tracking screen showing 5-step timeline; manager login lands on dashboard (stats 47/3/4/57170 د.ع), Orders tab shows autoprint-toggle+per-order print buttons, Add(scan) tab shows web camera-unavailable notice + manual barcode entry which auto-fills name/category from catalog, Products tab lists 47 products with edit/delete; delivery login shows assigned orders each with Yandex static map preview, phone/address, 'فتح الملاحة' and 'التوصيل عبر الخرائط' navigation buttons, and delivery-confirm button on out_for_delivery orders. Fixed one backend bug (missing _id strip in clean_product causing POST /api/products 500).

minor.issue: FIXED: was returning 500 because response doc still contained MongoDB _id (ObjectId not JSON-serializable). Patched server.py clean_product to pop '_id'. Please review the fix.

issues: Deprecated web style prop warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow) and props.pointerEvents is deprecated (use style.pointerEvents) — cosmetic only, does not break anything but pollutes console.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.' Expected on react-native-web; not a blocker but consider guarding useNativeDriver:true with Platform.OS !== 'web'.

action_items: Review and keep the small server.py fix in clean_product (added p.pop('_id', None)) — required so manager can create products.
Optional: guard useNativeDriver on web to remove RCTAnimation warning.
Optional: migrate shadow* / props.pointerEvents to modern equivalents to clean up console warnings on web build.
Data hygiene: repeated backend test runs leave a few TEST_* products/users soft-deleted in DB; consider a cleanup job or hard-delete for test-prefixed rows if you want a clean product list.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py clean_product previously did not strip Mongo _id — any function returning a freshly-inserted doc (create_product) leaked ObjectId and 500'd. Fixed.
server.py: /api/orders POST returns the raw doc after insert_one; the pop('_id', None) at line 511 is correct — good.
server.py is 782 lines: nearing the 700-line ceiling, consider splitting into routers (auth/products/orders/admin/delivery) as it grows.
Env keys followed correctly: MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, JWT_SECRET; frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL properly.
All interactive elements had testID coverage — very good for automated testing.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (customer login+add-to-cart+checkout+order-tracking, manager dashboard+orders+autoprint+scan+manual-lookup+products, delivery orders+map preview+nav buttons)

seed_data_creation: Created a TEST_ order (ORDD3AF5242) via customer checkout during UI flow test; TEST_* users/products created by pytest fixtures. Backend seed (24 sample products + 3 role users + 12,688 catalog items) already present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://grocery-hub-1117.preview.emergentagent.com. Credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Barcode 8699449876882 in seeded catalog returns 'بهار مرسين'/غذائية. Sample seed products (24 items) live in server.py SAMPLE_PRODUCTS. To re-run backend tests: `cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Frontend: static Yandex map images used (no react-native-maps), expo-print not verified because print dialog is native; only presence of print buttons/toggle verified.
rca_of_issue: Root cause of the single backend 500: motor's insert_one mutates the provided dict by injecting _id (ObjectId). create_product then returned clean_product(doc) but clean_product did not remove _id, so FastAPI's jsonable_encoder failed on ObjectId. Fix: pop '_id' inside clean_product so every caller is safe.
